assertions.subject: renal abscesses
assertions.quote: Sepsis is one of the most severe complications of renal abscesses, occurring in up to 25% to 50% of cases

assertions.subject: renal abscesses
assertions.quote: Bacteremia, commonly caused by E coli and K pneumoniae, facilitates the hematogenous spread of infection

assertions.subject: renal abscesses
assertions.quote: Septic pulmonary emboli, characterized by multiple cavitary lung lesions on imaging, are a recognized consequence and occur in up to 10% of cases

assertions.subject: renal abscesses
assertions.quote: Although craniofacial necrotizing fasciitis secondary to renal abscess embolization is exceedingly rare

assertions.subject: perinephric abscess
assertions.quote: Infection extending beyond the renal capsule can lead to the formation of a perinephric abscess, a complication seen in 10% to 40% of cases

assertions.subject: perinephric abscess
assertions.quote: Perinephric abscesses are more challenging to manage than intrarenal abscesses and often require image-guided percutaneous drainage

assertions.subject: perinephric abscess
assertions.quote: However, with failure rates of up to 30%, open surgical intervention may be necessary
